response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their recent decade of experience centers on web/full-stack work (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the role's core requirement of hands-on modern C++ development. C++ exposure is limited to a short 2014–2015 stint and a bachelor thesis, and there is no evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT, or message-broker-based industrial systems. The systems-programming and low-latency background is relevant but not close enough to the role's core stack.
strengths: Deep experience with low-latency, high-throughput services (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background including systems languages (DLang, C/C++) and event-driven architecture
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience; last professional C++ role ended in 2015
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus), or IEC 62443 security background
Career trajectory oriented toward web/full-stack and AI tooling, not embedded/industrial platform development

key_factors.factor: Low-latency systems and event-driven architecture experience
